# External Data (`data/external/`)

This directory is reserved for future supplementary datasets from external sources (e.g., electoral metadata, parliamentary sitting calendars, macroscopic economic indicators, or party manifestos) used to enrich the Hansard analysis.

## Conventions

- Document the source URL, retrieval date, license, and version of any external file added here in `docs/data_dictionary.md`.
- All data files in this directory are excluded from Git version control.
